This is exactly what g19-fixture-corpus.v2 supports, since its leftoverDesignClosedIfAcceptedAndRecorded is empty, its whatIsNotAuthored names 'per-platform copies of these bytes', and its leftoverDesignRemainingOnG19 is ["OBL-G19-FX-AUTHORING"].

Every deictic and every unstemmed version token that the v5 bytes carried is repaired, and the repairs introduce no new bare token colliding with version integer 6.

The DR-124 boundary holds: OBL-GRANT-JOURNAL, OBL-INHERIT-BLOCKED and OBL-MONOTONIC are neither claimed, remasured, nor invented, and state-class leftover-join.v4 is cited only for what it actually measures.
